entryWatch.setup: MDT day-3 pullback INTO the post-earnings base - THE SPECIFICATION WAS WITHDRAWN AT 10:21 AND REMAINS DEAD. Re-quoted hourly because the kill, not the entry, is this board's open question. This is the hour the tape stopped arguing against it.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD BY WITHDRAWAL, NOT BY EXPIRY, AND THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK. The 09:47 buy of 4 MDT at a 92.01 limit was killed by the 10:21 hourly on two of its own five published invalidations, five hours before its 15:30 fuse. RE-QUOTED LIVE THIS RUN: MDT 92.64 bid / 92.66 ask at 2026-09-03T18:22:21.679118955Z, last 92.65, +0.499% against a 92.18 settled close, on a 0.02 spread that is 0.022% of mark. THE COUNTERFACTUAL NARROWED FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE KILL - 6.04 on four shares against 6.36 an hour ago, having peaked at 6.88 when MDT printed 92.85 in the 17:30Z bar. Both shelf closes, 92.04 and 92.18, remain reclaimed, so the 13:21 finding that the 91.47 break reads as a false break of a shelf that held STILL STANDS AS THE STRONGEST CASE AGAINST THIS BOARD'S OWN KILL, and the kill still stands anyway: a published invalidation that fired is not reclassified after the price recovers, and a 90.965 print below the 91.47 low is a permanent fact. THE 13:21 COUNTERWEIGHT IS WITHDRAWN ON ITS OWN NEXT QUOTE: that run qualified MDT's edge by noting XLV had gone green, so part of the outperformance was sector rather than name. On this hour's quotes that no longer holds - every one of the four medtech peers is red and all four are WORSE than an hour ago, SYK -1.227%, ZBH -0.663%, BSX -2.357%, ABT -1.829%, while MDT is +0.499%, FIRST of five and the only green one. XLV's +0.069% is being carried by something other than devices, so MDT's edge is name-specific after all. Written down because it cuts against the previous hour's own qualification, and the file updates in both directions or it is worth nothing. The 92.01 limit sits 0.65 below the 92.66 offer, narrower than 0.73, and is still not re-struck - a dead level does not become live by the tape drifting back toward it.
entryWatch.why: TWO CORRECTIONS THIS HOUR, POINTING IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, AND BOTH ARE PUBLISHED BECAUSE A BOARD THAT ISSUES ONLY THE CORRECTION THAT FLATTERS IT IS NOT RUNNING A PROCESS. FIRST, AGAINST THIS BOARD: the counterfactual cost of the kill has stopped growing. Three consecutive runs reported it widening - 4.84, 5.44, 6.36 on four shares - and this hour it is 6.04, having PEAKED AT 6.88 on a 92.85 print in the 17:30Z bar around 13:35 ET. MDT stalled there and has closed lower in four consecutive ten-minute bars. The worst moment of the withdrawal has already happened and is receding, and that is written down on the hour the direction turned rather than on the hour it becomes comfortable. SECOND, AGAINST THE PREVIOUS RUN'S OWN CAVEAT: the 13:21 note softened MDT's outperformance by observing that XLV had gone green at +0.139%, so part of the 0.463-point edge was sector rather than name. That does not survive its own next quote. XLV is +0.069% while every medtech peer is red and every one is worse than an hour ago - SYK -1.227%, ZBH -0.663%, BSX -2.357%, ABT -1.829% - with MDT +0.499%, first of five and the only green one. The index's gain is coming from elsewhere in healthcare, so the edge is name-specific after all and the caveat is withdrawn. THE KILL STANDS ANYWAY, AND ONLY ONE REASON SURVIVES ALL OF THAT: the entry published five invalidations in advance, with nothing at stake, precisely so that no later run would have to judge the trade by how the price felt. Invalidation one was a trade below 91.47; it fired, repeatedly, and 90.965 is permanent. Both shelf closes, 92.04 and 92.18, are still reclaimed, so the false-break reading remains the strongest case against the kill - and reclassifying a fired invalidation as a false break AFTER the recovery is the same move as widening a stop because the position came back, which this board would refuse instantly under its own name. A pre-registered test is worth something only when it is honoured on the occasions it looks wrong. If the test was badly specified - the prior session low may be too tight a trigger on a shelf whose floor is being probed - the place to fix it is the NEXT entry's invalidation list, written before the fact, not this one's disposition after it. THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THIS HOUR THE REFUSAL FACES THE OPPOSITE ARGUMENT FROM LAST HOUR'S: the gap has NARROWED to 0.65 below the 92.66 offer from 0.73, and closing distance is no more a reason to reach for a dead level than widening distance was. It is dead by withdrawal, not by distance. THE COUNTERFACTUAL IS WORTH ONLY WHAT IT IS: sixteen delivery misses and four consecutive unexecuted specifications say the 6.04 assumes a fill that probably never happens.
